words.example: The acting supervisor can approve leave requests until June.
words.exampleZh: 在六月之前，代理主管可以批准请假。

words.example: An interim lead will run the desk while she is away on leave.
words.exampleZh: 她休假期间，由一位临时负责人来看这个柜台。

words.example: The permanent post will be advertised once probation decisions are done.
words.exampleZh: 试用期的决定做出之后，这个正式岗位就会对外公布。

words.example: We took on temporary clerks for the winter registration rush.
words.exampleZh: 我们为冬季挂号高峰招了临时文员。

words.example: The full-time opening at reception closes for applications on Friday.
words.exampleZh: 接待处这个全职空缺，周五停止接受申请。

words.example: An uncorrectable error on disk five means the array can no longer repair that block.
words.exampleZh: 五号盘出现不可纠正错误，阵列已经修不好那个块了。

words.example: The reallocated sector count on disk five jumped overnight, so order a replacement.
words.exampleZh: 五号盘的重映射扇区计数夜里跳了一截，去订一块替换盘。

words.example: Spin-up of the archive shelves takes almost a minute after the nightly idle.
words.exampleZh: 夜间休眠之后，归档盘柜的磁盘启动差不多要一分钟。

words.example: A head crash on that old shelf destroyed the only copy of the 2014 studies.
words.exampleZh: 那个旧盘柜磁头损坏，把 2014 年检查的唯一副本毁了。

words.example: Put the database on SSD (Solid State Drive) and leave the bulk images on spinning disks.
words.exampleZh: 数据库放在 SSD（固态硬盘）上，大批影像仍放在机械盘上。
